item.title: Ocala man sentenced for fleeing from MCSO deputies in stolen patrol car
item.description: An Ocala man will spend two decades in prison after jurors found him guilty of stealing a Marion County Sheriff’s Office patrol vehicle and leading law enforcement authorities on a high-speed chase. item.title: We pay school taxes as seniors because we want our caretakers to have knowledge
item.description: "You are educating those who are going to take care of you when you no longer can do so for yourself. I am sure someone else paid school taxes for you as a child as well. I don't like it either, but I do want my medical caretaker to have knowledge." - An Ocala resident shares her opinion.
